svg.title: What an operator can deploy, beside 24 agent sessions
svg.desc: Each of 7 configurations beside 24 agent sessions of the traces with the largest contexts, a row under its family, in panel a its voice-to-voice p95 on a log scale against the SLO of 2.02 s, the median of its runs and their range, and in panel b the agents' tokens a second over the calls, only the change and preempt-resubmit coming near the SLO: tuned vLLM, the baseline, 10.14 s at 3,710 tokens/s; 1,024-token steps, no long-prefill threshold, 8.79 s at 4,097 tokens/s; a token reservation, 2,048 tokens, 5.67 s at 3,564 tokens/s; SGLang with HiCache, 4x, write-through, 11.95 s at 4,723 tokens/s; preempt-resubmit, before the first byte, 2.59 s at 3,630 tokens/s; the lifecycle policy, over make-room, 2.06 s at 3,411 tokens/s; the configuration to deploy, 48-token window, 2.19 s at 3,493 tokens/s.
svg.text: vLLM tuned by its own settings
over the calls • higher is better
